location: Hallow Farm, a stone farmhouse on the upper moor road
scene_description: A stone farmhouse on the moor road, two storeys under a slate roof, timber floors upstairs. Rain has begun and the wind is rising; a full moon stands behind the cloud. In the kitchen the fire is banked for the night, the wall clock ticks loudly, and a traveller sits on the edge of the box bed with his boots off. Nell Hale is at the hearth, mending. Old Mrs Hale sleeps in the room directly above the kitchen. Gideon Hale is out in the byre with a lamp.

hallow_kitchen.name: the kitchen
hallow_kitchen.desc: The farmhouse's living room, floored in flagstone and roofed with dark beams, its lime-washed walls smoke-darkened above the hearth. A box bed is built into the west wall, its curtain half drawn on a rail. A stone hearth with a blackened iron crane stands in the north wall, and a scrubbed pine table with a bench along one side stands under the small east window. A wall clock hangs above the table. A plank door in the south wall gives on the yard, a door in the north wall on the back kitchen. Peat and split wood are stacked beside the hearth.

adjacent.name: the door to the back kitchen
adjacent.desc: a low plank door, painted once and gone grey, with a wooden latch worn smooth by hands

adjacent.name: the plank door to the yard
adjacent.desc: a heavy plank door with an iron sneck and a bar across it, draught coming under it

box_bed.desc: a box bed built into the west wall, its panels painted a dull green gone chalky at the edges, a curtain on a rail half drawn; the mattress is straw and the blankets are grey wool, worn thin

fire.desc: a stone hearth set into the north wall, its lintel soot-black, an iron crane and a pair of firedogs standing on a bed of grey ash; the flagstones before it are scorched and hollowed

table.desc: a scrubbed pine table bleached pale and scored by years of knives, with a bench along its south side and a bread board and a knife left on it

hearth_stool.desc: a low three-legged stool of dark oak, its seat worn hollow in the middle, standing on the flags before the hearth

hallow_agnes_room.name: old Mrs Hale's room
hallow_agnes_room.desc: A small bedroom under the slate, its timber floor laid over the kitchen's ceiling beams. An iron bedstead stands against the north wall with a wooden chair beside it holding a jug and a folded shawl; a rag rug lies on the boards and a small window sits in the east wall. The room is cold and smells of camphor and old wool.

adjacent.name: the door to the landing
adjacent.desc: a thin panelled door that does not sit true in its frame, with a gap of a finger's width under it

agnes_bed.desc: a low iron bedstead against the north wall, its paint chipped down to rust, with a flock mattress, a heap of grey blankets and a bolster

hallow_byre.name: the byre
hallow_byre.desc: A long stone shed across the yard, roofed with slate and floored with cobbles, its walls whitewashed to shoulder height and dark above. Wooden stalls run along the east wall with a stone gutter before them; hay and a bin of bruised oats are kept against the north wall. The air is thick with the smell of cattle, dung and damp straw.

adjacent.name: the byre door
adjacent.desc: a wide half-door of boards, the lower leaf shut and the upper leaf hooked back

byre_stalls.desc: a row of wooden stalls along the east wall, the boards dark with dung and rubbed smooth at the rails, with a stone gutter running before them and iron ties set in the posts

byre_fodder.desc: a stack of hay and a wooden bin of bruised oats against the north wall, the hay musty and warm, a pitchfork leaning in it

ash_penrose.name: Ash Penrose
ash_penrose.description: A lean, weather-tanned figure in the late twenties, medium height, with ink-stained fingers and steady grey eyes.

gideon_hale.name: Gideon Hale
gideon_hale.description: A big man grown thick through the shoulders and chest, hands like shovels, face lined deep by weather and loss; moves slowly, as though calculating the cost of every step.

nell_hale.name: Nell Hale
nell_hale.description: A lean, quick-moving girl of nineteen, brown-haired and grey-eyed, with wind-chapped hands and a brisk, watchful carriage; pretty in an unfussed way, the sort of face that looks younger until it opens its mouth.

agnes_hale.name: Agnes Hale
agnes_hale.description: A frail old woman, small and narrow, with a sharp-boned face and a thin querulous mouth. White hair hidden under a nightcap. Pale, lined skin, papery and loose over the knuckles and collarbones. Hands knotted with arthritis. Moves slowly and with effort.

kitchen_fire.name: the kitchen fire
kitchen_fire.description: A low fire of peat and split wood on the hearth's ash bed, red at the heart with a thin flame, the turfs glowing at the edges.

state.burning: low and steady, banked for the night

kitchen_clock.name: the kitchen clock
kitchen_clock.description: A wall clock in a dark wooden case, its face yellowed and its hands thin as wire, hung on the wall above the table.

ash_lantern.name: the tin lantern
ash_lantern.description: A tin lantern with a horn pane, soot-darkened, hanging by a wire hook from the pack.

ash_chain.name: the surveyor's chain
ash_chain.description: A surveyor's chain of iron links, oiled and coiled, looped over the shoulder.

ash_notebook.name: the leather notebook
ash_notebook.description: A leather-bound notebook, half filled with surveys and sketches in pencil and ink.

ash_brandy.name: the bottle of brandy
ash_brandy.description: A bottle of brandy wrapped in cloth and tied with a ribbon, packed as a gift.

gideon_lamp.name: Gideon's lamp
gideon_lamp.description: A tin oil lamp with a sooty glass chimney and a wire handle.

the_red_cow.name: the red cow
the_red_cow.description: A red-and-white cow standing in the stalls, head down over the fodder, breath steaming.

the_yearling.name: the yearling
the_yearling.description: A shorthorn yearling in the far stall, lying on the straw with its legs tucked.
